## What happens with more customers?

<!-- Editable version: switched by `show.more-customers-editable`. -->

```{=html}
<!--
  Law of large numbers slide for "Insure the Class", editable version.
  Same as round1-more-customers-slide.qmd, except the first row's number of
  customers is a box you can type into during the talk (e.g. the class size).
  Changing it clears the runs so far. Uses its own class names (llc-*) so it
  cannot clash with the fixed version.
  Each run simulates every pool size: each customer claims with
  probability data-claim-prob, and each claim costs data-claim-cost.
  The dots show the average cost per customer from every run so far;
  the latest run is gold.

  "Show theory" shades where about 95% of runs should land:
  expected +/- 1.96 standard deviations, where the standard deviation of the
  average cost is claim cost x sqrt(p(1 - p) / n). It halves each time the
  pool gets four times bigger.

  Settings (on the .llc div below):
    data-claim-cost  cost of one claim in dollars (default 600)
    data-claim-prob  chance a customer claims, as a decimal or fraction (default 1/6, a 1 on a die)
    data-sizes       pool sizes to compare (default 20,100,1000); the first is
                     only the starting value of the editable row
    data-axis-max    right end of the scale in dollars (default 300)
    data-axis-step   gap between scale labels in dollars (default 50)
-->
<div class="llc" data-claim-cost="600" data-claim-prob="1/6" data-sizes="20,100,1000" data-axis-max="300" data-axis-step="50">
  <div class="llc-grid" data-out="grid"></div>
  <div class="llc-tools">
    <button type="button" class="llc-btn" data-act="one">Simulate once</button>
    <button type="button" class="llc-btn" data-act="many">Simulate 20 times</button>
    <span class="llc-count" data-out="count">No runs yet</span>
    <span class="llc-spacer"></span>
    <button type="button" class="llc-small" data-act="theory">Show theory</button>
    <button type="button" class="llc-small" data-act="reset">Reset</button>
  </div>
</div>

<style>
.reveal .llc {
  --llc-accent: #24476b;
  --llc-mark: #a8322a;
  --llc-gold: #be830e; /* $anu-gold in custom.scss */
  --llc-line: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  --llc-line: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent);
  text-align: left;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  margin-top: 0.2em;
}
.reveal .llc .llc-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 6.5em 1fr 230px;
  column-gap: 28px;
  row-gap: 14px;
}
.reveal .llc .llc-label { align-self: center; font-size: 0.6em; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; }
.reveal .llc .llc-n {
  font: inherit; font-weight: 700; width: 4.2em; padding: 0.05em 0.25em;
  color: var(--llc-accent); text-align: right;
  border: 2px solid var(--llc-line); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent;
}
.reveal .llc .llc-n:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--llc-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.reveal .llc .llc-label small { display: block; font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.75em; opacity: 0.7; }
.reveal .llc .llc-track {
  position: relative; height: 104px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--llc-line);
}
.reveal .llc .llc-band {
  display: none; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--llc-mark) 12%, transparent);
  border-left: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--llc-mark) 40%, transparent);
  border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--llc-mark) 40%, transparent);
}
.reveal .llc.show-theory .llc-band { display: block; }
.reveal .llc .llc-exp {
  position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 0;
  border-left: 2px dashed var(--llc-mark);
}
.reveal .llc .llc-dot {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 18px; height: 18px; margin: -9px 0 0 -9px;
  border-radius: 50%; background: var(--llc-accent); opacity: 0.3;
}
.reveal .llc .llc-dot.is-latest {
  width: 26px; height: 26px; margin: -13px 0 0 -13px; opacity: 1;
  background: var(--llc-gold);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff;
}
.reveal .llc .llc-result { align-self: center; border-top: 3px solid var(--llc-gold); padding-top: 6px; }
.reveal .llc .llc-avg { font-size: 1.1em; font-weight: 700; color: var(--llc-gold); line-height: 1.1; }
.reveal .llc .llc-lab { font-size: 0.45em; opacity: 0.75; margin-top: 3px; }
.reveal .llc .llc-range { font-size: 0.45em; margin-top: 3px; min-height: 1.3em; }
.reveal .llc .llc-range b { font-weight: 700; }
.reveal .llc .llc-sd { visibility: hidden; font-size: 0.45em; color: var(--llc-mark); font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px; }
.reveal .llc.show-theory .llc-sd { visibility: visible; }

.reveal .llc .llc-axis { position: relative; height: 3.4em; margin-top: -8px; font-size: 0.45em; }
.reveal .llc .llc-tick {
  position: absolute; top: 4px; transform: translateX(-50%);
  font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap;
}
.reveal .llc .llc-tick.is-exp { color: var(--llc-mark); }
.reveal .llc .llc-axis-lab { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 1.9em; text-align: center; opacity: 0.75; }

.reveal .llc .llc-tools { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; margin-top: 4px; }
.reveal .llc .llc-spacer { flex: 1; }
.reveal .llc .llc-btn {
  font: inherit; font-size: 0.5em; font-weight: 700; color: var(--llc-accent);
  padding: 0.4em 1em; border: 2.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 12px;
  background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
}
.reveal .llc .llc-btn:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 9%, transparent); }
.reveal .llc .llc-count { font-size: 0.45em; opacity: 0.7; }
.reveal .llc .llc-small {
  font: inherit; font-size: 0.42em; padding: 0.35em 0.9em; color: inherit;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--llc-line); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
}
.reveal .llc button:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: default; }
.reveal .llc button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--llc-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var money = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-AU', { style: 'currency', currency: 'AUD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  var fmt = function (v) { return money.format(v); };
  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  document.querySelectorAll('.llc:not([data-ready])').forEach(function (root) {
    root.dataset.ready = '1';
    var cost = Number(root.dataset.claimCost) || 600;
    var prob = function (s, d) { var m = String(s || '').split('/'); var v = m.length === 2 ? Number(m[0]) / Number(m[1]) : Number(s); return v > 0 && v < 1 ? v : d; };
    var p = prob(root.dataset.claimProb, 1 / 6);
    var axisMax = Number(root.dataset.axisMax) || 300;
    var axisStep = Number(root.dataset.axisStep) || 50;
    var sizes = (root.dataset.sizes || '20,100,1000').split(',').map(Number);
    var expected = p * cost;
    var pct = function (v) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(v / axisMax, 1)) * 100 + '%'; };
    var grid = root.querySelector('[data-out="grid"]');
    var count = root.querySelector('[data-out="count"]');
    var buttons = root.querySelectorAll('button[data-act]');
    var runs = 0;

    // Build one row per pool size
    var rows = sizes.map(function (n, idx) {
      var label = document.createElement('div');
      label.className = 'llc-label';
      if (idx === 0) {
        label.innerHTML = '<input type="number" class="llc-n" min="1" max="100000" step="1" aria-label="Number of customers in the first row"><small>customers</small>';
        label.querySelector('input').value = n;
      } else {
        label.innerHTML = n.toLocaleString('en-AU') + '<small>customers</small>';
      }
      var track = document.createElement('div');
      track.className = 'llc-track';
      var band = document.createElement('div');
      band.className = 'llc-band';
      var exp = document.createElement('div');
      exp.className = 'llc-exp';
      exp.style.left = pct(expected);
      track.append(band, exp);
      var result = document.createElement('div');
      result.className = 'llc-result';
      result.innerHTML =
        '<div class="llc-avg">–</div><div class="llc-lab">Latest run</div>' +
        '<div class="llc-range"></div>' +
        '<div class="llc-sd"></div>';
      grid.append(label, track, result);
      var row = { n: n, track: track, band: band, sd: result.querySelector('.llc-sd'), avg: result.querySelector('.llc-avg'), range: result.querySelector('.llc-range'), values: [], latest: null };
      setTheory(row);
      return row;
    });

    // Theory band and 95% range for a row's pool size
    function setTheory(r) {
      var sd = cost * Math.sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / r.n); // standard deviation of the average cost
      var lo = Math.max(0, expected - 1.96 * sd), hi = Math.min(axisMax, expected + 1.96 * sd);
      r.band.style.left = pct(lo);
      r.band.style.width = ((hi - lo) / axisMax) * 100 + '%';
      r.sd.textContent = '95% of runs: ' + fmt(Math.max(0, expected - 1.96 * sd)) + ' to ' + fmt(expected + 1.96 * sd);
    }

    // Editable first row: a new pool size clears the runs so all rows stay comparable
    var nInput = root.querySelector('.llc-n');
    function applyN() {
      var v = Math.round(Number(nInput.value));
      if (!(v >= 1)) v = rows[0].n;
      v = Math.min(v, 100000);
      nInput.value = v;
      if (v === rows[0].n) return;
      rows[0].n = v;
      setTheory(rows[0]);
      reset();
    }
    nInput.addEventListener('change', applyN);
    nInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation(); // typing digits should not move the slides
      if (e.key === 'Enter') { applyN(); nInput.blur(); }
    });

    // Scale under the tracks; the expected cost replaces the plain label it lands on
    var axis = document.createElement('div');
    axis.className = 'llc-axis';
    for (var v = 0; v <= axisMax; v += axisStep) {
      if (Math.abs(v - expected) < axisStep / 2) continue;
      var t = document.createElement('span');
      t.className = 'llc-tick';
      t.style.left = pct(v);
      t.textContent = fmt(v) + (v === axisMax ? '+' : '');
      axis.appendChild(t);
    }
    var et = document.createElement('span');
    et.className = 'llc-tick is-exp';
    et.style.left = pct(expected);
    et.textContent = 'Expected ' + fmt(expected);
    axis.appendChild(et);
    var al = document.createElement('div');
    al.className = 'llc-axis-lab';
    al.textContent = 'Average cost per customer';
    axis.appendChild(al);
    grid.append(document.createElement('div'), axis, document.createElement('div'));

    function simulate(n) {
      var k = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) if (Math.random() < p) k++;
      return (k * cost) / n;
    }

    function runOnce() {
      rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var a = simulate(r.n);
        r.values.push(a);
        if (r.latest) r.latest.classList.remove('is-latest');
        var d = document.createElement('span');
        d.className = 'llc-dot is-latest';
        d.style.left = pct(a); // anything past the scale sits on its right edge ("$300+")
        d.title = fmt(a);
        r.track.appendChild(d);
        r.latest = d;
        r.avg.textContent = fmt(a);
        if (r.values.length > 1) {
          r.range.innerHTML = 'Range <b>' + fmt(Math.min.apply(null, r.values)) + ' to ' + fmt(Math.max.apply(null, r.values)) + '</b>';
        }
      });
      runs++;
      count.textContent = runs + (runs === 1 ? ' run' : ' runs');
    }

    function reset() {
      rows.forEach(function (r) {
        r.values = [];
        r.latest = null;
        r.track.querySelectorAll('.llc-dot').forEach(function (d) { d.remove(); });
        r.avg.textContent = '–';
        r.range.textContent = '';
      });
      runs = 0;
      count.textContent = 'No runs yet';
    }

    function setBusy(busy) {
      buttons.forEach(function (b) { if (b.dataset.act !== 'theory') b.disabled = busy; });
    }

    root.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var b = e.target.closest('button[data-act]');
      if (!b || b.disabled) return;
      b.blur(); // keep reveal.js arrow-key navigation working
      var act = b.dataset.act;
      if (act === 'one') runOnce();
      else if (act === 'reset') reset();
      else if (act === 'theory') {
        var on = root.classList.toggle('show-theory');
        b.textContent = on ? 'Hide theory' : 'Show theory';
      } else if (act === 'many') {
        if (reduceMotion) { for (var i = 0; i < 20; i++) runOnce(); return; }
        setBusy(true);
        var left = 20;
        (function step() {
          runOnce();
          if (--left > 0) setTimeout(step, 90);
          else setBusy(false);
        })();
      }
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
